description: The jump cancel as an ordinary edge, and the executed worst case nearly doubles through a door the model prices as dead (M1.3(b3), ADR-018). The patch APPENDS the opt-in jump move -- prejump 4, one upward key at fighter_a's own cited-but-unread 1280 impulse, bound to exactly Up so the built-in level jump gates off -- and one on-hit edge stand_hk -> jump at the family's delay 5, now literal frames instead of a delay glossary entry. The MODEL keeps its bound (TERMINATING, worst 21): the hk->jump edge is in its graph, but jump's hitstun is 0, so everything beyond it is priced dead. The GAME walks through the door: stand_hk, cancel into the jump, ride the arc, chain the aerials the stance now permits, land, continue -- the executed worst case goes 7 -> 13, found by a search whose jump entry is movement wearing a move's shape (it connects nothing and succeeds by completing at the first airborne actionable tick). The bound held from the other side, at nearly twice the distance.
